claim_scores.rationale: Sets `global_lm` via `dspy.configure`, then uses `with dspy.context(lm=france_lm)` inside `forward` for France before calling the predictor.
Uses `time.sleep(0.2)` during execution, including inside the France override scope, to create overlap between concurrent workers.
Invokes `dspy.Parallel(num_threads=2)` on two `(program, {"question": ...})` pairs, matching DSPy's dict-unpacking parallel API.
Asserts `answers == ["Paris", "Berlin"]`, showing the France request used the override LM and Germany used the default LM.
Prints and asserts `dspy.settings.lm is global_lm` after parallel execution, checking the override did not leak back to the main thread.
